title: Budget
description: Shared bounded-execution budget for every query, traversal, search, export and viewport expansion (PRP-01 clarification 15; NS-05, NS-06). timeout_ms, limit and max_depth are mandatory. The maxima here are contract ceilings; the server may clamp to lower policy values and reports the effective values and any truncation in Page. Not a standalone document, so it carries no schema_version.

limit.description: Maximum rows (or root items) per page.

max_depth.description: Maximum traversal depth. 0 for non-graph queries.

max_nodes.description: Maximum graph nodes returned (viewport budget). Absent means the server policy default, never unbounded.

max_edges.description: Maximum graph edges returned (viewport budget). Absent means the server policy default, never unbounded.
